snippet.title: Ghoul Fright Steam Trailer | Steam Next Game Fest 2025
snippet.description:
WE ARE SO BACK PEOPLE! AND WE'RE DESTROYING STEAM WITH THIS ONE FOLKS! 💀🔥

Carefully crafted by a team of hopeless pirates called PirateBlood Studios.
A fresh new gameplay trailer from the team!

Take control of Walter F. Junior, a seasoned entrepreneur who harbors a deep grudge against the Ghouls, creatures that ruin human lives. To keep the family business he inherited, “Ghoul Fight,” and win back his ex‑partner, 
Walter must face a sinister criminal mafia that traffics in Ghouls, all while securing lucrative contracts for the company and, if luck is on his side, reclaiming everything that was once his.

Inspired by the old Cartoon Network era, Ghoul Fright welcomes you back into these times, all while punching some teeth out from a dumb Ghoul! Using legacy 2D drawing Animation style brought into the 3D world

WISHLIST THE GAME →  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343580/Ghoul_Fright/
